build_DPTOutputAdapter: build a DPT output adapter module to decode ViT encoder tokens into spatial feature maps for regression or segmentation
create_ResidualConvUnit_custom: create a residual convolution unit with two conv layers, optional batch norm, and a skip connection
create_FeatureFusionBlock_custom: create a feature fusion block that merges two feature maps with residual units and bilinear upsampling
build_make_scratch: build a scratch module with four conv2d layers to project multi-scale feature maps to a uniform dimension
review_DPTOutputAdapter_forward: review the DPTOutputAdapter forward method that fuses four ViT layer hooks through refinement stages into a final output
